snippet.title: SOCOM 4 U.S. Navy SEALs - PS3 Gameplay (2011)
snippet.description:
SOCOM 4 U.S. Navy SEALs - PS3 Gameplay (2011)

Subscribe: http://goo.gl/01dGfm

SOCOM 4 U.S. Navy SEALs (known as SOCOM Special Forces in PAL regions) is a tactical shooter video game developed by Zipper Interactive and published by Sony Computer Entertainment exclusively for PlayStation 3. It's the sequel to SOCOM 3 U.S. Navy SEALs.

Online multiplayer servers were shut down on January 28, 2014, along with the servers for SOCOM U.S. Navy SEALs: Confrontation.


Recorded by Elgato Game Capture 4K60 Pro + OBS Studio
